dsh-llm-cost is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Per-turn and session-wide LLM cost metering: a dollar cost line under each message, a session cumulative total with hover breakdown, and an LLM+web price auto-refresh tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-49f4f89eae13588d4e23.html
